name: http-lab
description: A teaching-oriented raw HTTP/1.x lab built with Electron and Node.js.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace client-core && npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace app
scripts.build:main: npm run build --workspace client-core && npm run build --workspace server && npm run build:main --workspace app
scripts.dev: npm run build:main && npm run dev --workspace app
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start --workspace app
scripts.server: npm run build --workspace server && npm run start --workspace server
